moveEffects.name: Bite
moveEffects.originalDescription: Deals damage to enemies in front of the user. If the enemy HP is below 50%—or falls below that percentage as a result of this move—they become immobilized for 0.6s.

moveEffects.name: Rock Polish
moveEffects.originalDescription: Charge ahead in the designated direction, dealing damage to any enemies hit. If this move hits any enemy, all damage is increased by 15% for 3s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Tyrannical Rampage
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Briefly becomes unstoppable and explodes with anger, then goes on a rampage for 10s, gaining 50% tenacity for the duration. While rampaging, changes the auto attack pattern, dealing increased damage. Damaging a Pokémon from the opposing team below 20% max HP with these auto attacks deals 40% max HP as true damage to the target (sufficient damage reduction effects can prevent the target from being knocked out). Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
